append.text: **Ps 71:16 *Et erit firmaméntum in terra* → *E haverá esteio na terra*** (the local decision D31 left open): draft 1 *sustento* was heard as food first by the Latinist (minor, 'slides to the Hebrew's grain') and the ambiguity reader; *esteio* (στήριγμα, a prop) taken in v2 and passed the gate. Options *sustento*, *mantimento*, *firmamento*.

**Ps 71:10 *múnera ófferent … dona addúcent* → *oferecerão dádivas … levarão presentes*** — *dádivas* for múnera, *presentes* for dona (two Latin words, two Portuguese). The stylist asked *dons* (proparoxytone at the mediant) — held as at 44:13, option; the ambiguity reader listed *dádivas* unknown.
**Ps 71:3 *Suscípiant montes pacem pópulo* → *Acolham os montes a paz para o povo*** — the place this row named; no reader remarked; *Recebam* the option.
**Ps 71:13 *Parcet páuperi et ínopi* → *Poupará o pobre e o carente*** — applied; no reader remarked on the verb. Options *Terá compaixão do*, *Será clemente com*.

**Ps 71:12 *et páuperem, cui non erat adjútor* → *e o pobre que não tinha quem o auxiliasse*** — a local departure from *auxílio*: the v1 Latinist and stylist both asked for the person (*quem o ajudasse*); taken in the row's own verb (adjuváre → auxiliar) because here there is no *meus* formula, only a man without a helper. *auxílio*, *auxiliador* options. The gate passed it.
**Ps 71:19 *et replébitur majestáte ejus omnis terra* → *e toda a terra será cheia da sua majestade*** — the passive kept; the stylist asked *se encherá* (MS1932), held for this row, option.
**Ps 71:13 *páuperi et ínopi* → *o pobre e o carente*** (D38); the stylist asked *necessitado* ('social-work vocabulary') — refused: egénus's word.
**Ps 71:10 *dona addúcent* → *levarão presentes*** (D42) — the Latinist asked *trarão* twice (minor, v1 and gate: movement toward the king); held for D42 and *afférre → trazer*, option.
**Ps 71:6 *sicut stillicídia stillántia super terram* → *como gotas que gotejam sobre a terra*** — followed; the figura etymologica kept (*gotas … gotejam*); no reader remarked.
**Ps 71:8 *ad términos orbis terrárum* → *até os confins do mundo*** — 64:8's *confins* and 18:5's *do mundo* (D30); *os limites* the option.
**Ps 71:19 applied** (*assim seja, assim seja*), the close of Book II.

**Ps 71:18 *Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, * qui facit mirabília solus*** — the head copied (*Bendito o Senhor, Deus de Israel*); the tail differs from 40:14 → *que só ele faz maravilhas* (decision `solus`; the ambiguity reader could hear 'does only wonders' second; options *sozinho*, *o único que*).
**Ps 71:14 *Ex usúris et iniquitáte* → *Das usuras e da iniquidade*** — the plural kept; unknown to the ambiguity reader; kept for the reproach.

terms: | oríri | nascer (*Nascerá nos seus dias a justiça*) | open | Ps 71:7 *Oriétur in diébus ejus justítia* (ἀνατελεῖ, of a rising star or a sprouting plant); the Advent use (Adv1-1, Adv2-0, Adv3-0, Adv3-3 — grep) hears the birth. *Surgirá*, *Aparecerá* options. Other places (grep before use): 96:11 *Lux orta est justo*, 111:4 *Exórtum est* (exoríri), 84:12 *Véritas de terra orta est*. No reader remarked. |

| prócidere | prostrar-se (*Os etíopes se prostrarão diante dele*) | open | Ps 71:9 (προπεσοῦνται); 94:6 *Veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum* — the Invitatory — must be weighed with it (grep). v2 order subject first (the stylist: *etíopes* proparoxytone at the mediant). |

| vellus | lã (*Descerá como a chuva sobre a lã*) | open | Ps 71:6, only place (grep); πόκος, the fleece (Gideon, Jdg 6:37). Draft 1 *o velo*: unknown to the ambiguity reader and misheard (*véu*, *velho*); v2 *a lã* (the stylist's). **The Latinist asked *o velo* back on the gate (minor) — held; for Gustavo:** the concrete fleece vs a first hearing that goes wrong. |

| fænum | feno (36:2, *como o feno, depressa secarão*) / erva (71:16, *florescerão como a erva da terra*) | open | χόρτος both times, grass. Split by what the verse does: at 36:2 it dries (hay is right); at 71:16 it flowers — the stylist ('hay does not flower') and the ambiguity reader (heard dry hay) both refused *feno* there; *erva* (MS1932) taken in Ps 71 v2 and passed the gate. Other places: grep before use. If one word is wanted everywhere, *erva* is the candidate. |

| donum (the kings' gifts) | presentes (*os reis dos árabes e de Sabá levarão presentes*) | open | Ps 71:10b; kept apart from múnera → dádivas in the same verse. 67:19 *accepísti dona in homínibus* — check its wording (grep). |

| honorábilis | digno de honra (*e o nome deles será digno de honra diante dele*) | open | Ps 71:14b, only place (grep); τίμιον. Draft 1's participle *honrado* — the Latinist: the adjective is 'worthy of honour'; taken in v2; the copula's future supplied (DRB *shall be*). |

| adoráre de ipso | adorar por (*e sempre adorarão por ele*) | open | Ps 71:15 (προσεύξονται περὶ αὐτοῦ — 'pray for him'); the Latin's *adoráre* kept, *de* kept open as *por*; the ambiguity reader heard 'adore him' first, 'pray for / through him' next. Options *e o adorarão sempre*, *e sempre orarão por ele* (the Greek). |

| lingere terram | lamber a terra (*e os seus inimigos lamberão a terra*) | open | Ps 71:9b (λείξουσιν χοῦν — 'dust', but the Latin says *terram*); the Latin's image kept against *beijarão*; *lamberão o pó* (the Greek) the option. No reader remarked. |
formulas: | *Reges Tharsis et ínsulæ múnera ófferent: * reges Árabum et Saba dona addúcent. Et adorábunt eum omnes reges terræ: * omnes gentes sérvient ei* (71:10–11; Epiphany, Sancti/01-06 — Offertory and Office, grep) · *Oriétur in diébus ejus justítia et abundántia pacis* (71:7; Advent — Adv1-1, Adv2-0, Adv3-0, Adv3-3) · *Et dominábitur a mari usque ad mare* (71:8; Advent, 10-DU) | *Os reis de Társis e as ilhas oferecerão dádivas: * os reis dos árabes e de Sabá levarão presentes. E o adorarão todos os reis da terra: * todas as nações o servirão* · *Nascerá nos seus dias a justiça, e a abundância da paz* · *E dominará de mar a mar* | open — Ps 71; 71:11 in the Latin's order (draft 1's *Todos os reis da terra o adorarão* rhymed with *servirão*) |
